Name: Paprika Bottle 15 gm
LongDescription: Paprika bottle is full of paprika. Paprika is made of red fruits such as red bell pepper, sweet pepper, and capsicum annum. Beginning, similar to all chili peppers, in the Americas, paprika peppers are currently firmly connected with Hungarian food. Paprika can extend in flavor from mellow and sweet to searing hot and is utilized vigorously in Eastern European cooking. The Spice House offers six assortments of paprika zest. It has a sharp taste when warmed which brings out its peppery starting points. The red zest is most natural to Americans as a beautiful enhancement for deviled eggs and dish ham, paprika is produced using ground hat pepper, or Capsicum a relative of bean stew peppers and ringer peppers and local to South America. It gives you a great flavor added to different foods like pizza, pasta, spaghetti, etc.
